content.what_it_is: Top-level MATLAB driver for the FUNWAVE-TVD wave_coherence spectrum generator (WKDATA2D wavemaker input). Pipeline: (1) Get_Inputs writes and load inputs.mat restores all parameters (L3); (2) Zero_Coherence_Spectrum generates the baseline directional spectrum without coherent components, returning idx_theta, freq_resolution, freq, theta, Spectrum_Energy, Hmo_each, reps, AG, host_freqs_idx (L5-L6); (3) if Coherent_Percentage > 0, Coherence_Spectrum reassigns guest frequencies onto hosts and recomputes Spectrum_Energy, Hmo_each, reps, AG (L8-L11); (4) Plot_2D renders the 2D spectrum then closes figures (L14-L15); optional plots — Plot_Polar2D, Surf_3D, Plot_1Df_v2, Plot_1Dth — are commented out (L16-L30); (5) Write_to_file writes the wavemaker spectrum file with theta, freq, Hmo_each, mfreq, mtheta, Coherent_Percentage, fp, phase_include (L32-L33).
entities: idx_theta — direction index from baseline generator (L5)
freq — component frequencies, possibly coherence-modified (L5, L9)
variables from inputs.mat used here: Coherent_Percentage (L8), theta_mean (L14), fp (L14, L32), mfreq (L32), mtheta (L32), phase_include (L33)
unresolved: constants/params_defined/equations are empty: this driver defines no named constants or parameters of its own — every value comes from inputs.mat or callee returns; the anchored entity list above records where each is used.
Zero_Coherence_Spectrum, Plot_2D, and Write_to_file are sibling functions not in this file; the exact output file format of Write_to_file (the WKDATA2D wavemaker text) is not visible here.
The commented Plot_1Df_v2 call (L25) references a variable freq_no_coh that no live code defines, confirming the commented block is stale.
reps and AG returned at L6/L9 are unused by the live pipeline (not passed to Plot_2D or Write_to_file).
